scope: All 24 originally selected source-ID archives, including all unsupported taxa/siteyears and full provider/weather HOLDs; source selection never uses observed solar-weather association sign.
analysis_units: One equal-weight original repository study-ID/source archive regardless of number of GPS animals, taxon groups, selected 1-degree grid-years or weather observations. Within source: mean equally over each taxon's admitted weather site-year estimates, then over all admitted taxa. Do not infer original population independence from unique study IDs.
primary_summary: For each variable, report all source counts; if at least six different original source IDs have supported mean slopes, compute equal-source arithmetic mean and fixed seed 2000 source-block bootstrap percentile95, plus source leave-one-out min/max. No GPS-step or tagged-animal iid inferential test.
secondary_environment_context_correlatio: Spearman rank correlation across source-study means of source-group sunward heading cosine versus mean sampled ERA5 temperature
Spearman rank correlation across source-study means of source-group sunward heading cosine versus mean sampled ERA5 shortwave
Spearman rank correlation across source-study means of source-group sunward heading cosine versus mean sampled ERA5 100m wind speed
secondary_uncertainty: A descriptive source-ID bootstrap of Spearman correlation with 1000 resamples and leave-one-source-out range; no causal model or independent landscape p-value.
planned_outputs: Full 24 source-level manifest of group weather supports and missingness, source ID mean estimates, source-level group summary, all slopes/correlation signs/uncertainty even if no effect. Do not retroactively change v0 climate threshold or source-qualification rules.
forbids: No source subgroup search by favorable signs, publication-effect harvesting, outcome-based source replacement, global climate causation, wind mediation fraction, experimental sunlight avoidance, or calling independent 1-degree grid-year contexts independent ecosystems.
limitations: Study archive is not always a distinct ecosystem; source species and individual counts are not source-independent ecological replication. Weather source can change upon refetch. Conditioning on observed GPS intervals and modal source grid-years may bias population representativeness.
outcome_inference: Exploratory cross-source observations only; clusters are archived study-ID descriptors. Even source bootstrap CIs represent variability of sampled source studies, not scientifically representative world's biomes.
